def features(xy, model, decay):
    (r, c) = xy.T
    (u, v) = ((r - 7.5) / 7.5, (c - 11.5) / 11.5)
    (dr, dc) = (np.minimum(r, 15 - r), np.minimum(c, 23 - c))
    e = np.exp(-np.minimum(dr, dc) / decay)
    (er, ec) = (np.exp(-dr / decay), np.exp(-dc / decay))
    es = np.exp(-r / decay) + np.exp(-(15 - r) / decay) + np.exp(-c / decay) + np.exp(-(23 - c) / decay)
    cols = {'scalar': [], 'linear': [u, v], 'min': [e, u, v], 'minQ': [e, u, v, u * u, v * v, u * v], 'sum': [es, u, v], 'sumQ': [es, u, v, u * u, v * v, u * v], 'axis': [er, ec, u, v], 'axisQ': [er, ec, u, v, u * u, v * v, u * v], 'union': [er, ec, er * ec, u, v], 'border': [np.minimum(dr, dc) == 0, u, v], 'quadratic': [u, v, u * u, v * v, u * v]}[model]
    return np.column_stack([np.ones(len(r)), *cols])

def reg(A, y):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    x = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)[0]
    return least_squares(lambda v: A @ v - y, x, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.012).x
